title: Vocabulary Export Freshness Watch
dataSources: Reviews (`language:review`), lessons (`language:lesson`), immersion sessions (`language:immersion`), tutor sessions (`language:tutor`), sync states (`language:sync`).
app: Language-learning telemetry — Anki review logs, Duolingo lessons, Babbel course exports, immersion-hour trackers, and tutor-session notes — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=language:sync source_name=* source_event_epoch=* export_epoch=*
| eval lag_hours=round((export_epoch-source_event_epoch)/3600,1)
| stats avg(lag_hours) as avg_lag_hours, max(lag_hours) as worst_lag_hours by source_name
| sort - avg_lag_hours
description: Measures vocabulary export lag by data source for language-learning syncs.
value: Lag tracking shows which data source create the slowest handoffs, syncs, or review loops inside language-learning syncs.
implementation: Capture the timestamps needed to compute `vocabulary export lag` on `language:sync` events and aggregate them by `source_name`.
visualization: Table of data source with average and worst vocabulary export lag.
grandmaExplanation: It gathers how long things take for each data source so you can see where language-learning syncs slows down.
